headline: Union contract talks, a $385,000 Head Start Infrastructure Grant, and a proposed change to the acceptable use policy on smart glasses.
summary: The agenda includes closed-door sessions on union contract talks and past executive session minutes. Open items cover grants, payments, school donations, policy changes, and a proposed smart glasses rule for students.
items: Executive session on collective bargaining strategy with Educational Association of Worcester units
Executive session on negotiations with nonunion personnel, including School Committee Executive Administrator and Clerk Kristi Turgeon
Executive session on review of executive session minutes from August 13 and September 17, 2026
Consent agenda: 12 donations to schools and programs, from $91.80 to $6,700.65
Consent agenda: notification of new hires, non-instructional staff hires, and resignations or retirements
Report of the Superintendent: New State Graduation Requirement, recommended to approve and file
Operations and Governance report: quarterly facilities report on building maintenance timeframes
Policy updates to ECAF Security Cameras in School, IHBG Home Schooling, and JFBB School Choice
Boundary realignment report, approved and held for future forums
Response on a gender support plan request, approved and filed with a request for more information
Update on girls flag football at WPS, approved and filed
Common assessments and statewide assessments by grade, and a request for a K-12 testing calendar, approved and filed
FY27 Innovation Career Pathways Implementation and Support grant, $45,915
Head Start Infrastructure Grant from the Department of Health and Human Services, $385,000
UMass Memorial Medical Center Community Benefits Mini Grant, $5,000
Seven prior-year payments totaling $6,165.11
Prior-year payment to an employee, $330.00
Prior-year payment to an employee, $8,322.57
Funding for the GearUp Program at North High School, recommended to approve and file
Purchase of National Geographic's Cengage curriculum for the Multilingual Education Department, not to exceed $1,500,000
Study of a digital hall pass system in secondary schools, recommended to approve and file
Feasibility report on expanding after school and athletics transportation, recommended to approve and file
Proposed revision to Policy IJNDB Acceptable Use Policy on smart glasses and wearable technology, referred to Operations and Governance
Resolution in Support of Head Start Programs
Easement to National Grid on Oberlin Street and Woodland Street
Standing annual recognition of October as Italian-American Heritage and Culture Month
Updated Report of the Superintendent schedule for the 2026-27 school year
Standing annual recognition of Hispanic Heritage Month, September 15 through October 15
Review and update of School Choice policy JFBB, referred to Operations and Governance
Contract for employment with Kristi Turgeon as School Committee Executive Administrator and Clerk
Selection of a delegate and alternate for the MASC/MASS Joint Conference, November 4-7, 2026
Public comment
